meeting_point: the Boston Women's Memorial on the Commonwealth Avenue Mall near the intersection of Commonwealth Ave and Fairfield Street.
accessibility: mostly flat surfaces and little to no inclines. Stroller and wheelchair accessible.
description:
This family-friendly guided stroll through Boston’s historic Back Bay tells the story of a reclaimed swamp where elegant buildings now stand. Take a quick 'time hop' to the Victorian Gilded Age to learn the stories of people who lived and worked in Back Bay, and discover the community they created in this interactive tour specially designed for kids ages 8-12 and their families.

PLEASE NOTE: All children must be accompanied on the tour by a ticketed adult.
what_is_included:
- Guided 60 minute outdoor tour exploring Boston's urban landscape
- 0.5 mile tour at a moderate pace, stopping at various sites along the tour
